judge.voice: Ok, it was actually less annoying than school. Sam talked like a real teammate, not like a textbook, and he argued back, which I liked. One correction, "more better", fair, I fixed it and got back to the game in one click. No lecture. The other mistakes waited for the end, good, because I hate being stopped every sentence. But it was over after three replies and the recap's mission line, "choose a fresh context", is just filler. Sam also kept saying "right?" about Turbo Rift like a bot. Do I trust the level? B1 feels right. Would I use it again? Only if my parents push me, maybe ten minutes. Would I tell a friend? Maybe, if the games topic stays.
